CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
  version integer PRIMARY KEY CHECK (version >= 1),
  name text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  checksum text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  state text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('running', 'done')),
  started_at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  finished_at text COLLATE "C"
)

CREATE TABLE state (
  singleton integer PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
  epoch bigint NOT NULL CHECK (epoch >= 0),
  holder text COLLATE "C"
)
INSERT INTO state (singleton, epoch, holder) VALUES (1, 0, NULL)

CREATE TABLE counters (
  singleton integer PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
  audit_seq bigint NOT NULL CHECK (audit_seq >= 0),
  delivery_seq bigint NOT NULL CHECK (delivery_seq >= 0)
)
INSERT INTO counters (singleton, audit_seq, delivery_seq) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

CREATE TABLE aggregates (
  kind text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  id text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1),
  body text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  created_at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  updated_at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (kind, id)
)

CREATE TABLE operations (
  operation_id text COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  request_hash text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  actor text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  correlation_id text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  result text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE audit (
  seq bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  operation_id text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES operations (operation_id),
  correlation_id text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  actor text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  type text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  subject_kind text COLLATE "C",
  subject_id text COLLATE "C",
  detail text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE deliveries (
  delivery_id text COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  seq bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  destination text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  ordering_key text COLLATE "C",
  priority integer NOT NULL CHECK (priority BETWEEN 0 AND 9),
  aggregate_kind text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  aggregate_id text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  aggregate_revision bigint NOT NULL,
  payload text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  state text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'delivered')),
  attempts integer NOT NULL CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  next_attempt_at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  claimed_until text COLLATE "C",
  token text COLLATE "C",
  last_error text COLLATE "C",
  receipt text COLLATE "C",
  delivered_at text COLLATE "C"
)
CREATE INDEX deliveries_open ON deliveries (destination, next_attempt_at, priority DESC, seq) WHERE state <> 'delivered'
CREATE INDEX deliveries_open_key ON deliveries (destination, ordering_key, seq) WHERE state <> 'delivered' AND ordering_key IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE effects (
  effect_id text COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  operation_id text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES operations (operation_id),
  attempt_id text COLLATE "C",
  target text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  input_digest text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  reconciliation_handle text COLLATE "C",
  status text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('intended', 'uncertain', 'confirmed', 'failed')),
  evidence text COLLATE "C",
  created_at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  updated_at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE timers (
  timer_id text COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  due_at text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  aggregate_kind text COLLATE "C",
  aggregate_id text COLLATE "C",
  payload text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  state text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'completed', 'cancelled')),
  attempts integer NOT NULL CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  claimed_until text COLLATE "C",
  token text COLLATE "C"
)
CREATE INDEX timers_open ON timers (due_at, timer_id) WHERE state IN ('pending', 'claimed')
